name: Forest
description: Place forests anywhere. Each forest tile scores by level. 2 Points for level 1 and another 2 Points for level 2.

name: Tall Forest
description: Place forests anywhere. Each forest tile scores by level. 1 Points for level 1 and 4 more Points for level 2.

name: Large Forest
description: Place forests connected to each other. The more forests are connected the more points you earn. Level 2 forets earn an additional 2 points.

name: Field
description: Place fields in pairs. A pair of fields earns 10 points. Adding more fields to a pair doesnt earn more points.

name: Small Fields
description: Place fields alone. Each field earns 5 points. A field connected to another field doesnt earn any points.

name: Large Fields
description: Place fields in groups of 3. A group of fields earns 20 points. Adding more fields to the group doesnt earn more points.

name: Mountains
description: Place mountains connected to another mountain. Mountains that are not connected to another mountain dont earn points. Each level of a mountain earns 3 additional points.

name: Tall Mountains
description: Place mountains connected to another mountain. Mountains that are not connected to another mountain dont earn points. The higher the mountain the more points you earn.

name: Isolated Mountains
description: Mountains score if they are NOT connected to another mountain. They score more when leveled up to higher levels.

name: Long River
description: Make long rivers. Dont create clusters of rivers but stretch them out. The longer the river the more points you earn.

name: Short River
description: Make short rivers. Dont create clusters of rivers but stretch them out. The longer the river the more points you earn up to a maximum of 5 river tiles.

name: River
description: Place rivers anywhere. Each river earns 4 points.

name: Wetland
description: Place wetlands in between other types of tiles. A wetland earns 12 points if its connected to a minimum of 3 different neighboring types. Different tile levels dont affect the scoring.

name: Wetland Neighbors
description: Place wetlands in between other types of tiles. A wetland earns 4 points per adjacent tile type. Different tile levels dont affect the scoring.

name: Wetland Group
description: Place wetlands in pairs. A pair of wetlands earns 15 points. Adding more wetlands to a pair doesnt earn more points.
